package baseline

// Generator of the ctfkit baseline vectors (ctfkit pkg/verdict/testdata). Run
// against a provider checkout at the commit that SOURCE.json names, with
// this file copied into internal/baseline:
//
//	CTFKIT_VECTORS=/path/to/ctfkit/pkg/verdict/testdata go test ./internal/baseline/ -run CtfkitVectors
//
// It fills readdigest/cases.json digests, writes controlmanifest/expected.json
// and baseline/valid/{baseline.json,expected.json}, all computed by this
// package. The baseline is signed with fresh in-memory keys (no private key
// is written) and must pass Load.

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/hkdf"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-go/tftypes"

	"github.com/compliancetf/terraform-provider-aws/internal/bundle"
	"github.com/compliancetf/terraform-provider-aws/internal/profile"
	"github.com/compliancetf/terraform-provider-aws/internal/trust"
	"github.com/compliancetf/terraform-provider-aws/internal/verdict"
	"github.com/compliancetf/terraform-provider-aws/internal/verdict/verdicttest"
)

type rdCase struct {
	Name    string          `json:"name"`
	Reads   []string        `json:"reads"`
	Value   json.RawMessage `json:"value"`
	Unknown [][]string      `json:"unknown"`
	KeyHex  string          `json:"key_hex,omitempty"`
	Digest  string          `json:"digest"`
}

type rdFile struct {
	KeyHex   string          `json:"key_hex"`
	KReadHex string          `json:"k_read_hex"`
	Type     json.RawMessage `json:"type"`
	Cases    []rdCase        `json:"cases"`
}

func TestCtfkitVectors(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("CTFKIT_VECTORS")
	if root == "" {
		t.Skip("CTFKIT_VECTORS not set")
	}
	rd := readDigestVectors(t, filepath.Join(root, "readdigest", "cases.json"))
	ctls := controlVectors(t, filepath.Join(root, "controlmanifest"))
	baselineVector(t, filepath.Join(root, "baseline", "valid"), rd, ctls[0])
}

func readDigestVectors(t *testing.T, path string) map[string]string {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var f rdFile
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &f); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	typ, err := tftypes.ParseJSONType(f.Type) //nolint:staticcheck // cty JSON type syntax
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	k, _ := hex.DecodeString(f.KeyHex)
	kr, err := hkdf.Key(sha256.New, k, nil, infoReadDigest, 32)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.KReadHex = hex.EncodeToString(kr)
	out := map[string]string{}
	for i := range f.Cases {
		c := &f.Cases[i]
		key := k
		if c.KeyHex != "" {
			key, _ = hex.DecodeString(c.KeyHex)
		}
		v, err := tftypes.ValueFromJSON(c.Value, typ) //nolint:staticcheck // test input
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", c.Name, err)
		}
		v = markUnknown(t, v, c.Unknown)
		d, ok := ReadDigest(key, c.Reads, v)
		if !ok {
			d = ""
		}
		c.Digest, out[c.Name] = d, d
	}
	writeIndented(t, path, f)
	return out
}

// markUnknown replaces the value at each path with an unknown; a "*" step
// matches every element of a list, set or tuple.
func markUnknown(t *testing.T, v tftypes.Value, paths [][]string) tftypes.Value {
	v, err := tftypes.Transform(v, func(p *tftypes.AttributePath, x tftypes.Value) (tftypes.Value, error) {
		for _, want := range paths {
			if stepsMatch(p.Steps(), want) {
				return tftypes.NewValue(x.Type(), tftypes.UnknownValue), nil
			}
		}
		return x, nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return v
}

func stepsMatch(steps []tftypes.AttributePathStep, want []string) bool {
	if len(steps) != len(want) {
		return false
	}
	for i, s := range steps {
		var got string
		switch s := s.(type) {
		case tftypes.AttributeName:
			got = string(s)
		case tftypes.ElementKeyString:
			got = string(s)
		case tftypes.ElementKeyInt:
			got = strconv.FormatInt(int64(s), 10)
		case tftypes.ElementKeyValue:
			got = "*"
		}
		if want[i] != "*" && got != want[i] || want[i] == "*" && got != "*" && strings.Trim(got, "0123456789") != "" {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

type ctlExpected struct {
	Index  int    `json:"index"`
	ID     string `json:"id"`
	Digest string `json:"digest"`
}

func controlVectors(t *testing.T, dir string) []bundle.Control {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "controls.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var each []json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &each); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var exp []ctlExpected
	var ctls []bundle.Control
	for i, c := range each {
		got, err := bundle.ParseControls(append(append([]byte("["), c...), ']'))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("control %d: %v", i, err)
		}
		d, err := digestJSON(&got[0])
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		exp = append(exp, ctlExpected{i, got[0].ID, d})
		ctls = append(ctls, got[0])
	}
	writeIndented(t, filepath.Join(dir, "expected.json"), exp)
	return ctls
}

type keyOut struct {
	Kid       string `json:"kid"`
	SPKIB64   string `json:"spki_b64"`
	Use       string `json:"use"`
	NotBefore string `json:"not_before"`
	NotAfter  string `json:"not_after"`
}

type baselineExpected struct {
	Now             string   `json:"now"`
	BaselineKey     keyOut   `json:"baseline_key"`
	StatementKey    keyOut   `json:"statement_key"`
	SignedSHA256    string   `json:"signed_sha256"`
	StatementSHA256 []string `json:"statement_signed_sha256"`
	EntryDigests    []string `json:"entry_digests"`
}

func baselineVector(t *testing.T, dir string, rd map[string]string, ctl bundle.Control) {
	vnow := time.Date(2026, 10, 19, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	bl, rc := verdicttest.NewKey(t, vnow.Add(-24*time.Hour)), verdicttest.NewKey(t, vnow.Add(-24*time.Hour))
	bl.Signer.Use, rc.Signer.Use = verdict.UseBaseline, verdict.UseReceipt
	prof := &profile.Profile{OrgID: "bobthecorp", Baseline: &profile.Baseline{PublicKeys: []profile.SignerKey{bl.Signer}, MaxDays: 90},
		BreakGlass: &profile.BreakGlass{ReceiptKeys: []profile.SignerKey{rc.Signer}}}
	manifest, err := digestJSON(&ctl)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	content := "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("3", 64)
	plan := "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("4", 64)
	issued := vnow.Add(-time.Hour).Format(time.RFC3339)
	entries := []Entry{
		{Workspace: "prod", Scope: Scope{"111111111111", "us-east-1"}, Type: "aws_s3_bucket", IdentityKind: "id",
			Identity: map[string]string{"id": "bkt-1"}, Address: "aws_s3_bucket.logs", Control: ctl.ID, ControlMajor: "2",
			ControlManifestDigest: manifest, ReadDigest: rd["base"], Approver: "alice@bobthecorp.example",
			Expires: "2026-12-01T00:00:00Z", Ticket: "BOB-123"},
		{Workspace: "prod", Scope: Scope{"111111111111", "us-east-1"}, Type: "aws_s3_bucket", IdentityKind: "identity",
			Identity: map[string]string{"bucket": "bobthecorp-ünïcode\t<b>", "account_id": "111111111111"}, Address: `module.m["a"].aws_s3_bucket.this[0]`,
			Control: ctl.ID, ControlMajor: "2", ControlManifestDigest: manifest, ReadDigest: rd["set order a"],
			Approver: "bob@bobthecorp.example", Expires: "2026-11-15T00:00:00Z", Ticket: ""},
	}
	var stSums []string
	for i := range entries {
		e := &entries[i]
		st := Statement{Format: StatementFormat, OrgID: "bobthecorp", Role: RoleApprover, Subject: e.Approver, Workspace: e.Workspace,
			Scope: e.Scope, RunID: "run-obs-1", PlanDigest: plan, ContentDigest: content, IssuedAt: issued}
		signed := signDoc(t, rc, st)
		if err := json.Unmarshal(signed, &e.ApproverStatement); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		_, sb, _ := verdict.SignedBytes(signed)
		stSums = append(stSums, sum(sb))
	}
	doc := Document{Format: Format, OrgID: "bobthecorp", IssuedAt: issued, ContentDigest: content, Entries: entries}
	body := signDoc(t, bl, doc)
	var pretty bytes.Buffer
	if err := json.Indent(&pretty, body, "", "  "); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "baseline.json")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, append(pretty.Bytes(), '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	keyPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "baseline.key")
	if err := os.WriteFile(keyPath, []byte(strings.Repeat("ab", 32)+"\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s, err := Load(LoadInput{Path: path, KeyPath: keyPath, Profile: prof, Revocations: trust.NoRevocations(),
		Coverable: func(string) bool { return true }, Now: vnow})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("provider Load refuses the vector: %v", err)
	}
	_, sb, _ := verdict.SignedBytes(body)
	ko := func(k profile.SignerKey) keyOut {
		return keyOut{k.KID, k.SPKIB64, k.Use, k.NotBefore.Format(time.RFC3339), k.NotAfter.Format(time.RFC3339)}
	}
	writeIndented(t, filepath.Join(dir, "expected.json"), baselineExpected{Now: vnow.Format(time.RFC3339),
		BaselineKey: ko(bl.Signer), StatementKey: ko(rc.Signer), SignedSHA256: sum(sb), StatementSHA256: stSums, EntryDigests: s.digests})
}

func signDoc(t *testing.T, k verdicttest.Key, v any) []byte {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(v)
	var m map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &m); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	delete(m, "signature")
	sig, _ := json.Marshal(verdicttest.Signature(t, k.Priv, k.Signer.KID, m))
	m["signature"] = sig
	out, _ := json.Marshal(m)
	return out
}

func sum(b []byte) string {
	s := sha256.Sum256(b)
	return hex.EncodeToString(s[:])
}

func writeIndented(t *testing.T, path string, v any) {
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
